text_block_list.text:
Having achieved the goal set with
<chrname>... 
there were several candidates for the
next 
target race, but—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
<chrname> accepted the race we finally
decided on. 
Let's do our best toward our next goal!
